assignment: Design COC + Sync script integration: embed hash tracking, manifest metadata injection, and mission graph routing in unified vault sync system

deliverables: SYNC-COC-ARCHITECTURE.md — Unified design (6 phases, error handling, success metrics)

design_summary.overview: Unified vault synchronization and chain-of-custody system replacing three separate systems (vault mutations, COC logging, mission graph sync)
design_summary.core_idea: Single sync-vaults-with-coc.py script handles change detection → hash computation → manifest association → frontmatter injection → COC logging in one transaction
design_summary.design_maturity: Architecture complete; ready for implementation review

key_design_decisions.decision: Unified Script vs. Three Separate Tools
key_design_decisions.rationale: Single entry point reduces coordination overhead, guarantees atomic operations, enables cross-phase data passing (hash → metadata → COC in one transaction)
alternatives_considered: Keep separate scripts (higher modularity but more coordination risk)

key_design_decisions.decision: Metadata Injection via Frontmatter (not separate sidecar files)
key_design_decisions.rationale: Vault files become first-class discoverable agents; wikilinks + mission field enable stigmergic routing directly from file system; one source of truth
key_design_decisions.selected_rationale: Frontmatter = native Obsidian integration; agents can [[wikilink]] directly

key_design_decisions.rationale: Before-hash proves file was in expected state at sync start (detects mid-operation corruption). After-hash proves sync didn't corrupt. Together: cryptographic proof of safe transition
key_design_decisions.selected_rationale: Two hashes = defensive: proves state A → [sync] → state B safely

key_design_decisions.decision: Wikilink Validation as Warning, Not Error
key_design_decisions.rationale: Some agents may reference future work (forward links). Validation is informational; preserves authorial intent. Broken links are warnings, not blockers
alternatives_considered: Block sync if broken links found
key_design_decisions.selected_rationale: Respect agent intent; catch issues without preventing work

key_design_decisions.decision: Mission Field as Primary Routing Unit (not investigation_label)
key_design_decisions.rationale: investigation_label is descriptive; mission is routing. Agents scan by mission; enables stigmergic clustering. Compass bearing + mission = complete navigation signal
key_design_decisions.selected_rationale: mission field already defined; enables immediate agent discovery

key_design_decisions.decision: Graceful Degradation when Manifest Not Found
key_design_decisions.rationale: Manifests may be delayed; sync should proceed and inject what it can. File gets basic metadata; warning logged. Catches up when manifest arrives
key_design_decisions.selected_rationale: System resilience: continues even when upstream data delayed

design_phases.name: Change Detection
design_phases.description: Scan faerie2/forensics + ct-vault + faerie-vault for changed files using mtime + size delta
inputs: Baseline hash state from prior sync
outputs: List of changed files with metadata
design_phases.complexity: O(n) where n = total vault files

design_phases.name: Hash Computation + Manifest Association
design_phases.description: For each changed file: compute SHA256(before/after), discover associated manifest
design_phases.fallback: Proceed without manifest if not found

design_phases.name: Vault Frontmatter Injection
design_phases.description: Inject manifest metadata into vault file frontmatter (task_id, mission, compass_bearing, etc.)

design_phases.name: COC Entry Creation
design_phases.description: Create chain-of-custody entry for each file sync; hash-chain to prior entries

design_phases.name: Wikilink Validation
design_phases.description: Verify all [[wiki-links]] in vault files resolve to existing targets
outputs: Validation report: valid count, broken count

design_phases.name: Operational Report
design_phases.description: Generate sync session report with metrics and status
metrics: Files processed, hashes verified, metadata injected, wikilinks checked

FRONTMATTER-METADATA-INJECTION-RULES.jso.structure: JSON schema with injection rules for 10 manifest fields

hash_strategy.before_hash: State of file before sync operation (proves expected baseline)
hash_strategy.after_hash: State of file after sync operation (proves no corruption)
hash_strategy.chain_semantics: prev_entry_hash → entry_hash links entries; unbroken chain = integrity verified
hash_strategy.verification: Recompute hash for each entry; verify matches stored entry_hash
hash_strategy.immutability_guarantee: Modifying any prior entry breaks chain; tampering detected immediately

metadata_injection_strategy.principle: One-way flow from forensics/ → vault frontmatter; never back-fill forensics from vault
metadata_injection_strategy.manifest_association: Three methods: task_id match (exact), basename similarity (fuzzy), timestamp proximity (temporal)
metadata_injection_strategy.graceful_degradation: If manifest not found, proceed without injection; log warning

mission_graph_integration.principle: Vault files become mission-discoverable via mission + compass_bearing fields
mission_graph_integration.mechanism: Agent scans forensics/manifests/{date}/ → filters by mission → groups by compass_bearing → navigates vault files as nodes
mission_graph_integration.wikilink_edges: [[task_id]] becomes natural edge in mission-graph DAG

error_recovery_strategy.design_principle: Recoverable errors are warnings; non-recoverable errors trigger rollback
non_recoverable_errors: COC write fails (rollback all vault changes; raise error)
Frontmatter validation fails (revert injections; preserve original)
error_recovery_strategy.rollback_mechanism: Snapshots created before any writes; restored on critical failure
